nodes.label: COTS CAD Download Workflow (McMaster-Carr / GrabCAD into SOLIDWORKS)
nodes.source_file: resend the _project scale and CAD Workflow_ file.txt
nodes.rationale: Professional practice: never model off-the-shelf parts; download supplier CAD so Simscape simulation uses exact mass/inertia, hours are saved, and SOLIDWORKS auto-generates a BOM with real part numbers.

nodes.label: Medium-Scale Industrial Project Framing (Fleet for a Specific Site)
nodes.source_file: resend the _project scale and CAD Workflow_ file.txt
nodes.rationale: One robust robot plus a modular AWH farm (20-150 units) for a specific ~1 MW site: commercial-grade but not mass-market, with the student acting as chief engineer for one operational site.
